body.name: fuzzyFamily
body.construction: For any admissible \(P_X\) and dyadic \(h\), use \(\mathcal B_h\), the disjoint supported bumps \(g_{h,j}\), and a uniform sign vector \(\omega\). Put \(u_\omega(x)=a_h\sum_j\omega_jg_{h,j}(x)\) and \(v_\omega(x)=b_h\sum_j\omega_jg_{h,j}(x)\), with \(a_h=c_\circ h^{\beta_e}\) and \(b_h=c_\circ h^{\beta_m}\). For \(u=u_\omega(x)\) and \(v=v_\omega(x)\), the complete conditional cell tables are \[p_\omega=\frac14\begin{array}{c|cc}&Y=y_+&Y=y_-\\\hline A=1&1+u+v+uv&1+u-v-uv\\A=0&1-u+v-uv&1-u-v+uv\end{array},\qquad q_\omega=\frac14\begin{array}{c|cc}&Y=y_+&Y=y_-\\\hline A=1&1+u-v+uv&1+u+v-uv\\A=0&1-u-v-uv&1-u+v+uv\end{array}.\] Equivalently, \(p_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)=(1+r_Au_\omega(x))(1+s_Yv_\omega(x))/4\), whereas \(q_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)=\{1+r_Au_\omega(x)-s_Yv_\omega(x)+r_As_Yu_\omega(x)v_\omega(x)\}/4\). The joint observed-data laws are \(dP_\omega=f_X(x)p_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)\,dx\) and \(dQ_\omega=f_X(x)q_\omega(r_A,s_Y\mid x)\,dx\), extended to full-data laws by drawing \(Y(0)\) and \(Y(1)\) independently from the displayed arm laws given \(X\) and then drawing \(A\) given \(X\). The two fuzzy hypotheses are the uniform mixtures over the shared sign vector \(\omega\).
